name: cf7-additional-types
description: Block editor styling and additional field types for Contact Form 7.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.start: npm run build:css && concurrently -k -n js,css "wp-scripts start editor=./src/editor/index.js fields=./src/fields/index.js --output-path=build" "tailwindcss --input src/styles/style.css --output build/style.css --watch"
scripts.make-pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/cf7-additional-types wp i18n make-pot . languages/cf7-additional-types.pot --exclude=node_modules,vendor,src,.wordpress-org
scripts.make-json: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/cf7-additional-types wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
